name: Tradify
summary: Specialized job management software for trade businesses. Handle quoting, scheduling, and invoicing from the field.
best_for: electricians, plumbers, HVAC and other trades businesses that want quoting, scheduling, job tracking and invoicing from the field in one simple app
skip_if: you're a solo operator who invoices from a spreadsheet happily, or you need heavy project-management/accounting depth rather than trades job management
honest_knock: Per-user pricing is honest and simple, but it means the cost scales linearly with headcount — a ten-person crew is a real monthly number, not the single-seat sticker. It's purpose-built for trades job management (quoting, scheduling, invoicing), so it's not a general project-management or accounting suite; you'll still run Xero or QuickBooks alongside it. For a trades business that's a feature, not a flaw.

pricing.notes: Per user, per month, quoted in USD on tradifyhq.com/pricing and re-verified 2026-10-02: Lite $47, Pro $51 and Plus $61 per user, plus a Custom tier for large teams that is priced on request. The 14-day free trial includes all features. The Instant Website add-on is $12 a month. There is no free plan and no volume ladder published on the page — the per-user rate is flat within a plan. One thing to get right before you search: the product lives at tradifyhq.com. The shorter tradify.com is a parked holding page that reads "Launching Soon" and is not the vendor (checked 14 September 2026).

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 29 October 2026 on the free trial: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We imported two made-up customers from a CSV, exported them, imported a changed copy and opened the Lite checkout without paying.
findings: The trial showed '14 Trial Days Left' with no card, matching 'Free for 14 days'. It includes all features; the checkout says there is no limit on staff during the trial.

Customers import from a template with four free custom fields. The import says existing customers 'will be updated' and that the changes 'cannot be undone'; it matched our columns by name and added both customers.
The customer export was the best of this round: our free text came back exactly, with its line break, quotes and accents, and every record carried a 'Tradify Id'.

Re-importing a copy with one field changed updated that customer in place: still two customers, the same IDs, nothing else changed. The import cannot map the Tradify Id, so it matches on something else, most likely the customer name.
Lite is $47 per user a month; the checkout adds staff without a login at $10 each a month. Pro is $51 and Plus $61. We stopped before 'Upgrade'.
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
